title: rewards.points.expired v1
description: Emitted for each FIFO-expired earn entry after the periodic expiration sweep runs. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-rewards-go, EventPublisher.PublishExpired (internal/service/events_publisher.go:241, event_type stamped at line 242), called from ExpirationWorker.runOnce (internal/service/expiration.go:178). Added 2026-07-03 (DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-rewards, option A2). FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) -- fields are top-level, matching the real producer: cmd/server/main.go:286 wires ExpirationWorker with the raw Redis-backed EventPublisher (not the outbox-backed one), so publish() (events_publisher.go:295) marshals the Event struct directly onto the 'payload' field of both the bare rewards.points.expired stream and the events:rewards domain mirror. There is no event_version, producer, or data wrapper on this wire shape; occurred_at replaces the envelope's timestamp field.

event_id.description: UUID identifying this event (auto-generated by EventPublisher.publish if the caller left it empty).

event_type.description: Stamped by PublishExpired. Consumers route on this exact value.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the expired points.

transaction_id.description: Ledger transaction id of the expiration entry (== original_id in this producer).

amount.description: Points expired for this earn entry.

balance_after.description: Account balance after this expiration, for audit.

reference.description: Free-form reference; this producer sets it to the original earn's transaction id.

original_id.description: Id of the earn entry that expired.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp the entry was configured to expire at.

occurred_at.description: Timestamp of the expiration sweep run (not the original earn time).
